_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/3/2 (footer code 2231/3/2), sibling of 31/3/1. 32 page images, folio = idx + 1. idx 0 bilingual cover, idx 1 Hindi General Instructions, idx 2 English General Instructions (no questions), then Hindi/English pairs: English on EVERY EVEN index 4-30 (idx 4 Q1-4, 6 Q5-7, 8 Q8-11, 10 Q12-14, 12 Q15-17, 14 Q18-22, 16 Q23-26, 18 Q27-29, 20 Q30-34(a)(i), 22 Q34(a)(ii)-35, 24 Q36, 26 Q37, 28 Q38-39(a), 30 Q39(b)-(c)), Hindi on every odd index 3-29. Odd pages checked on the contact sheet, idx 23 at full size: Devanagari from the top, no English overflow; the parity holds throughout. idx 31 (folio 32) is BLANK, confirmed at full size. Instructions (i)-(vii) confirm sci80. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 2-12, header 'Paper Code: 31/3/2', footer 'X SCIENCE 31/3/2') for a bare OR: after Q23, 25, 27, 34, 35, 36, 37 (c), 38 (c), 39 (c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Q35's alternative is printed unlabelled ('OR (a) ... (b) ...'), so its refs are Q35a/Q35b with the parts (a)/(b) kept inside each stem. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page as an image; each was re-derived and agrees; no void note anywhere in the scheme. 41 rows reuse 31/3/1's text byte for byte after a check against this paper's own page; 13 rows are new to this set (Q6, 9, 10, 17, 19, 20, 21, 26, 28, 30, 33, 35a, 35b). The Assertion-Reason instruction on THIS paper reads 'Q. 17 to 20 consists ...' (31/3/1's file has 'Q. Nos. 17 to 20'), transcribed as printed here. Decimal points on this PAPER are ordinary full stops (Q34(b)(ii): 1.5 cm); the scheme prints raised dots, not transcribed. The scheme heads Q34 with 'SECTION E' where the paper prints Section D; a scheme layout slip with no effect on any row.
